label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Sorry for the late reply da, needed a proper sit-down to answer this one. And Sneha, thanks, but Rohan is right to ask. He and Divya put real money in because they trusted me, so here's the straight version first and then you can all go back to roasting my LinkedIn.

Yes, I let 6 of 14 people go last Friday. Ajay, you can laugh at the cricket captain post, but honestly that was the worst day of my life. Worse than failing maths in 2nd sem, and you all know how much I cried about that. We gave everyone 2 months pay, and I've been calling everyone I know. 4 of them already have interviews lined up, so at least that part is moving.

Why it happened: we had a bridge round from a Hyderabad fund that was basically done. Term sheet was ready. It fell through on 28 Oct. The partner said "we love the energy" on the call and then went silent for 11 days. So now I know "we love the energy" means "bye". Without that money we had to cut, otherwise we'd have run out much faster and then it's everyone's problem.

Where we stand now:
- After the cuts we have about 5 months runway
- App has around 41k monthly users
- Plumbers and electricians side is actually growing
- AC servicing side is bleeding money, so we're shutting it down
- New focus is housing society tie-ups. 3 societies in HSR have already signed pilots

Rohan, about your 3 lakh, straight answer since you asked for one. It's at risk. It's not gone. I'm not going to say "don't worry machan, totally safe" because I genuinely don't know, and you and Divya deserve better than me acting confident in a WhatsApp group. Your money is in on the same terms as everyone else in the friends round, no difference. I really think the society model gives us a real shot, because the numbers there look much better than AC ever did. But a real shot is not a sure thing, and I won't pretend it is.

So no need to practise the sad face yet. Maybe keep it ready in the cupboard, ironed, just in case. I'm hoping you never need to take it out.

What I'd like to do is get on a proper call with you and Divya this week. Whatever evening works for you two. I'll walk you through the actual numbers: runway, the pilots, what has to go right, and what happens if it doesn't. Divya should hear it from me directly and not as a dinner table summary from you, no offence. Ask me anything. Tell me which day works.

For everyone else asking "is Karthik ok": I'm fine. Tired, but fine. My diet is mostly Maggi at office at 11pm. It's happened so many times that the security uncle now just asks "masala or plain sir?" without me saying anything. We have a relationship now. Also amma asked last week if TCS is still hiring. She was only half joking. Maybe 40% joking.

Anyway I'm 100% coming Saturday. I've earned one evening off where nobody says the word "runway". Pranav, since you're the one with a salary from an actual company, the beer is on you. That's how the funding works now. You're my new bridge round, and I love your energy. Please keep replying.

Rohan, seriously, thanks for asking straight and not just quietly worrying. Talk this week 🙏
